$comment: Solved Bitcoin-Puzzle private keys, as {puzzle_number: hex_key}. Used by spa.analysis.puzzle_pattern to test whether solved keys cluster (a 'hot zone') or are uniform (no exploitable pattern). Only the low, universally-published, trivially-verifiable keys are seeded here; for a meaningful uniformity test PASTE THE FULL solved list (through the latest solve) from privatekeys.pw. The analyser verifies each key falls inside its own [2^(n-1), 2^n) range, so a transcription error is caught, not silently averaged in.
